hero.title: Creative visual experiences shaped through art, design, and storytelling.
hero.summary: I am Neeta Bhusal, a multidisciplinary creative exploring graphic design, visual communication, filmmaking, and digital experiences with a calm and expressive approach.
hero.accent: Minimal aesthetics, emotional storytelling, and thoughtful visual direction.

about.bio: Neeta Bhusal is a Nepalese creative practitioner currently studying Humanities and Arts at GITAM University in India. Her work blends graphic design, visual storytelling, filmmaking, and digital creativity with emotionally driven narratives.
about.vision: Create meaningful visual experiences that inspire emotion, connection, and self-expression through art and storytelling.
about.mission: Transform personal experiences, creativity, and cultural influences into impactful digital and visual narratives.
